 2 more die of dengue; 1,615 hospitalised in a day
 Death toll rises to 510 as total cases reach 1,68,933 
 Published : 19 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 19 November 2026, 16:37
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least two dengue patients died and 1,615 others were hospitalised in 24 hours until 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Both deaths were reported from Dhaka division.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest deaths, the death toll rose to 510, while the cumulative number of cases reached 1,68,933.
 Currently, 5,617 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
